published.system: Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM)

statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 training split the grid program search solved 148 of 400 tasks (37 percent) with one attempt per task, no model and a 3000 ms wall clock budget per task, mean 1864.02 ms per task. 0 exhausted the vocabulary, 236 ran out of clock, 16 found a program that fit every train pair and missed a test output. Every solved answer is what a chain of grid.dsl cells emitted after grid.dsl.match cells confirmed every train pair. This is the TRAINING split, which the vocabulary was written against, so it is not comparable to the published row; the published no-model row is Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM) at 17 percent on the evaluation split.
